To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the microstructure of welding layer metal is composed of ferrite, pearlite and martensite, and the hardness of welding layer metal increases as the content of martensite phase increases.

the microstructure of the surfacing welding layer is mainly composed of acicular ferrite, bainite, pearlite and martensite, which are distributed in different areas, and the microhardness of the surfacing layer metal varies from 400 to 600HV.
the hardness of surfacing layer metal of A3 and45 steel is mainly influenced by the quantity and distribution of the hardening phase.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the microstructure and properties of surfacing welding layers of A3 and steel, which is of great significance to the application of surfacing welding technology in engineering practice.
the influence of the type, performance and quantity of hardening phase on the microstructure and mechanical properties of surfacing welding layers of A3 and45 steel.
the microstructure, hardness, wear resistance, impact toughness, and microhardness distribution of surfacing welding layers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the hardness of the weld metal is influenced by the microstructure, and the microstructural features are affected by the welding procedure parameters, the kind of electrode, the type, performance and distribution of harden phase, the quantity of harden phase and the type of steel base material.

the performance of surfacing layer is closely related to its microstructure, and the microstructures and performance of surfacting welding layer metal are closely related to the kind of electrode, welding procedure parameters, type, performance, distribution and quantity of hardening phase.
the microstructure of surfacing welding metal is the most important factor to determine the performance of surfacing layer metal.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the microstructure of surfacing welding metal of 45 steel is more complex than that of A3 steel.

the surfacing welding layer of A3 steel with the electrode of 1.6 mm and welding current of 150 A is the best, and the surfacing welding of 45 steel with the electrode size of 1.8 mm and welding current 160 A is the best.

, in order to improve the performance of the surfacing welding layer of A3 and45 steel, it is necessary to increase the content of hardening phase and the hardness of surfacing weld metal, and the content of hardenability phase and the hardness should be controlled at a certain level.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the microstructure of welding layer metal is composed of ferrite, pearlite, bainite and martensite.
the hardness of surfacing weld metal increases with the content of hardening phase, and the hardness decreases with the content of martensite phase.
the hardness of surfacing weld metal can be improved by increasing the amount of hardening phases and by increasing the size of hardening phases.
